root_cause: A carried pre-sleep observation was labeled current while the action audit simultaneously said post_dispatch_observation=missing. The larger current tree/image signal caused Reviewer to treat old evidence as a post-delay read.
repair: Sleep performs zero observation captures. At a missing-post-observation boundary the carried packet is labeled pre_action_observation and does not expose the citeable current handle. A Reviewer observe_screen call supplies current on the next round.

runs.audit: Sleep correctly captured zero observations, but no observe_screen call occurred and old evidence was reported as re-observed.
The explicit prompt rule was present, but the old observation was still labeled current; Reviewer again skipped observe_screen.
The frozen AMap route-preview precondition was absent after restart. The run was cancelled after the agent found AMap home and could not safely reconstruct the route without changing it.
After sleep, Reviewer called observe_screen(current), then reported the visible title Settings without entering or modifying an item.
Repeated from an already valid Settings-home precondition. Reviewer again called observe_screen(current) after sleep before done.

pre_freeze_repeat_result.conclusion: The causal labeling repair succeeded twice on valid low-risk device runs, but these runs preceded the exact Settings freeze and are supporting evidence only. The formal gate is recorded in sleep_action_settings_real_device_results.json.
